## New Problem: Timestamp format

The normalizer is receiving `raw.start_time` as just "18:00" (time only), not the full ISO timestamp. The Kulturhuset scraper outputs both `time` and `start_time`, but `mapToRawEventInput` is copying `event.time` to `raw.start_time` and `event.start_time` to `raw.start_time`.
